description: This file provides utility functions for file path normalization, directory creation, file hashing, file operations, MIME type detection, and other file management tasks used within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM project. It includes functions for cleaning paths, creating directories, generating MD5 hashes for files and directories, and managing filename safety.

methods.name: clean_path
methods.description: Normalizes file paths by replacing backslashes with forward slashes, removing duplicate slashes and './' segments, and handling Windows UNC paths.

methods.name: create_cache_directory
methods.description: Creates the necessary directory structure within the cache directory for a given file path.

methods.name: get_module_dir_list
methods.description: Returns a list of directories within the 'modules' directory, representing different modules.

methods.name: mk_temp_dir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory with a specified prefix within a base directory.

methods.name: remove_file_extension
methods.description: Removes the file extension from a filename.

methods.name: write_array_to_file
methods.description: Serializes an array to a PHP file with a specified variable name, with optional header.

methods.name: write_override_label_to_file
methods.description: Writes an associative array of labels into a PHP file, each assignment as a separate line.

methods.name: write_encoded_file
methods.description: Decodes base64 data and writes it to a file, verifying MD5 checksum afterward.

methods.name: create_custom_directory
methods.description: Creates a custom directory structure similar to create_cache_directory but within 'custom'.

methods.name: generateMD5array
methods.description: Recursively generates an array mapping file paths to their MD5 hashes, ignoring specified directories.

methods.name: md5DirCompare
methods.description: Compares two directory structures by MD5 hashes and returns differences.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Recursively retrieves files matching a pattern in a directory and its subdirectories.

methods.name: readfile_chunked
methods.description: Outputs a file in chunks, useful for large file downloads.

methods.name: sugar_rename
methods.description: Renames a file, unlinking the destination if it exists.

methods.name: fileToHash
methods.description: Creates an MD5 hash from a filename string and stores it in session.

methods.name: hashToFile
methods.description: Retrieves the filename associated with a given hash from session storage.

methods.name: get_file_extension
methods.description: Returns the extension of a filename, optionally in lowercase.

methods.name: get_mime_content_type_from_filename
methods.description: Guesses the MIME type based on the filename extension using a predefined mapping.

methods.name: cleanFileName
methods.description: Sanitizes a filename by removing non-word characters.

methods.name: cleanDirName
methods.description: Sanitizes a directory name by removing slashes and dots.

methods.name: hasValidFileName
methods.description: Checks if a filename is valid based on a specific regular expression pattern.
